ios.desc:
Thrivo is your companion for efficient daily planning. Manage your schedule, tasks, and habits with ease, all in one intuitive platform.

Take control of your routines, activities, and habits like never before. Thrivo allows you to track and analyze your progress, helping you optimise your day.

Thrivo not only helps you organize your day but also ensures that tasks due on the selected day are displayed in the timeline, keeping you informed and on track.

Experience the convenience of resolving overlapping events with just one click and effortlessly adjusting event start and end times by dragging up or down on the respective time.

Say goodbye to the hassle of manual input. With Thrivo, scheduling events is a breeze. Easily select from your pre-defined routines, activities, or to-dos, streamlining your day planning process for maximum efficiency.

Syncing your Apple Calendar events and reminders with Thrivo adds a layer of convenience to your planning process. By seamlessly integrating these features, you can effortlessly keep track of your commitments and tasks across platforms. This means that any events or reminders you've set up in your Apple Calendar will automatically populate within Thrivo, ensuring that your planning remains cohesive and up-to-date.

A monthly or yearly subscription is required to gain access to any of the features mentioned.

quotes.text:
I made this app because I have such flexible schedule that I needed a tool where I can organise and structure my days efficiently. 
All apps I tried had title based events (you had to type manually what you want to do each time). My app is based on the premise that most people do the same activities/routines every day: So when creating an event in this app, the user can just select the from the pre-created activities/routines instead of having to type it in manually. After you download the app you get 1 day completely free testing, after that you can use the code LAUNCH for another 2 months free use.
